latest_release.body:
We are thrilled to announce the release of version 0.3.0 of our project! This update brings further enhancements aimed at improving both the usability and functionality of the project.

## Key Changes:

### 1. Comprehensive Website Update

The website has been fully updated to offer a more immersive and user-friendly experience. Notably, we’ve introduced a new feature to Stay on Page, which allows you to seamlessly switch between different languages without losing your place. Additionally, we’ve enhanced the rendering of mathematical formulas, ensuring that equations are displayed correctly across all devices.

### 2. Expanded Problem Solutions

We have added even more detailed solutions to a wider range of problems. These updates will help you dive deeper into various topics, with clearer explanations and more advanced problem-solving techniques. Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, you’ll find valuable new insights to boost your learning journey.

## Project Growth:

We are proud to share that our project has seen tremendous growth. With 33,000+ stars and 8,400+ forks, it continues to gain recognition and support from the community. Thank you for making this project such a success!

## Thank You to Our Contributors:

As always, we want to thank our amazing community of contributors. Without your hard work, this release would not be possible. Your support makes a huge difference in the continued growth of this project.

@yanglbme @acbin @klever34 @rain84 @idoocs @djvelimir @AE-Hertz @07subhadip @lingxier @CodersAcademy006 @taoyq1988 @hongyiheng @sarvex
